about: Real-life can-do milestones. A milestone is assessed (inside a weekly assessment) only once every needed item has been introduced, and is marked passed only when every step is answered correctly without help. Steps are (item, skill) tasks, so the check uses the same validated exercises as the rest of the app. Viewing lessons never completes a milestone.

milestones.name: Order a meal and answer the staff
milestones.desc: Get seated, order, ask for water, say for here or to go, ask for the bill.

steps.say: The server greets you and asks…
Answer: there are two of you.
A little later the server asks…

milestones.name: Read common shop signs
milestones.desc: Open, preparing, closed, regular holiday, opening hours, sold out, tax included, discount.

milestones.name: Ask for and follow directions
milestones.desc: Ask where the station is and understand straight, left, right, corner, traffic light.

steps.say: Ask a passer-by where the station is.
You didn't catch the rest — ask them to repeat.

milestones.name: Explain a problem to your landlord
milestones.desc: Say what is broken or leaking and that you need a repair.

steps.say: Say the air conditioner is broken (pick the right form).
They mention this — what is it?
Another day: you've lost your key.

milestones.name: Introduce yourself and keep it going
milestones.desc: Name, where you're from, where you live, what you do, your hobbies — and ask back.

steps.say: The word for 'where one is from'.
Say where you live (live → the right form).
Ask about hobbies — the key word.

milestones.name: Handle unexpected questions without freezing
milestones.desc: Understand a sudden question, buy time, ask for a repeat or slower speech.

steps.say: Say you don't understand — that's a valid move.

milestones.name: Describe something you can't name
milestones.desc: Use thing / use / colour / shape / 'like…' to get your meaning across.

steps.say: What does this add to a description?

milestones.name: Pay at the konbini
milestones.desc: Understand 'shall I heat it?', decline a bag, pay by card, check the date label.

steps.say: The cashier says something with this word…

milestones.name: Take the train
milestones.desc: Buy a ticket, find the platform, change trains, get off at the right stop.

steps.say: Ask where to buy a ticket.
Tell the person next to you you're getting off.

milestones.name: Understand the main road signs
milestones.desc: Stop, slow down, no parking, one way, road closed, no overtaking, no U-turn, speed limit.

milestones.name: Explain symptoms at a pharmacy or clinic
milestones.desc: Say what hurts, that you have a fever, show your insurance card — or call an ambulance.

steps.say: Emergency: ask someone to call an ambulance.
